purpose: Review one finite family derived from the accepted point-in-time daily price-basis chain and select at most one genuinely new fixed formula before reading any Campaign136 source value, candidate value, comparator value, daily OHLC value or forward return.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_realized_price_basis_adjustment_magnitude_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.definition: For date t and the immediately preceding accepted local trading session p, require the same symbol to have valid rows on both dates, exact accepted price_basis and daily_source, and finite strictly positive factor_t and factor_p. Score abs(log(factor_t/factor_p)); exact equality is valid zero.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.economic_hypothesis: A larger close-known reference-price continuity adjustment can mark a realized capital-distribution or share-basis transition that causes short-lived attention and portfolio rebalancing from the next open through the third close. The source does not identify the official corporate-action type, so the factor is only a price-basis adjustment magnitude.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.prevalue_independence_case: The day-over-day ratio cancels the arbitrary per-symbol chain initialization, contains no raw or adjusted return magnitude, and uses a source state not present in the frozen 151-definition library.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_signed_price_basis_adjustment_direction_1d
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Choosing the ratio sign would search dividend, split, rights and source-rounding directions; magnitude is the single source-invariant question and direction is not opened.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_price_basis_adjustment_recency_or_decay_window
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Any 3/5/20/60-session carry, elapsed-age score or decay kernel introduces an arbitrary event window and mixes occurrence with persistence. Campaign136 fixes the same-day realized adjustment only.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: daily_price_basis_adjustment_event_indicator_with_tolerance
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: A basis-point, tick, percentile or learned threshold would convert a continuous accepted reconciliation magnitude into an arbitrary event classifier. Exact zero and source rounding remain in the selected fixed support.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: raw_close_return_minus_provider_pct_chg_reconciliation_gap
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: On the accepted chain it is an algebraic re-expression of the selected factor ratio while loading forbidden raw price and pct_chg fields; it adds no independent information.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: price_basis_adjustment_times_dividend_plan_or_old_factor_confirmation
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Combining this source state with the capacity-terminal dividend-plan family or any exposed factor would be a post-exposure confirmation rescue rather than a new single-source mechanism.
